name: Grand Hotel Zermatterhof
insider_take: A Belle Époque masterpiece where Matterhorn views meet timeless Alpine elegance in the heart of car-free Zermatt.
whats_special: This historic 1879 hotel sits directly on Bahnhofstrasse, Zermatt's main pedestrian street, offering unobstructed Matterhorn views from select rooms. The property features original Belle Époque architecture with modern Swiss luxury, including a world-class spa and multiple dining venues. As part of The Signature Collection, it maintains boutique character while delivering five-star service in one of Switzerland's most exclusive resort towns.
pro_tip: Book a south-facing Matterhorn view room on floors 3-5 for the most dramatic mountain vistas, and time your arrival via the scenic Glacier Express train for an unforgettable approach to this car-free Alpine paradise.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop terrace offers 360-degree Alpine views, while the nearby Gornergrat Railway (just a 5-minute walk) provides access to some of Europe's best Matterhorn viewpoints. The surrounding village features charming wooden chalets, luxury boutiques, and is the gateway to over 350km of hiking trails and world-renowned ski slopes.
pros: Prime location in car-free Zermatt village center
Spectacular Matterhorn mountain views from rooms and terraces
Historic Alpine charm with modern luxury amenities
Multiple dining venues including fine dining restaurant
cons: Car-free destination requires train or taxi transfer
